title: Udhaar likh liya, bhoolna nahi
caption:
Grahak ne maal liya, bola 'agle hafte doonga.' Aap kahan likhte hain? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a shopkeeper who writes down a pay-later sale before the next customer reaches the counter. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Ramesh: Ramesh is a cheerful grocery shopkeeper in his forties with a thin moustache, a checked shirt and a pen behind his ear.
cast.Sharma ji: Sharma ji is an elderly neighbourhood customer with white hair, a cotton kurta and a cloth shopping bag.

scenes.vo: दोपहर की भीड़ थी, दुकान पर लाइन लगी थी।
scenes.sub: Dopahar ki bheed thi, dukaan par line lagi thi.
scenes.art: Ramesh behind the counter of a busy small grocery store at noon, three customers waiting in a line, shelves of packets and jars behind him, bright daylight.

scenes.vo: शर्मा जी ने आटा और दाल उठाई।
scenes.sub: Sharma ji ne aata aur daal uthayi.
scenes.art: Sharma ji placing a bag of flour and a packet of lentils on the counter, Ramesh smiling and packing them.

scenes.vo: बोले, पैसे अगले हफ़्ते देता हूँ।
scenes.art: Sharma ji with folded hands and a friendly smile, Ramesh nodding at the counter, the line of customers behind.

scenes.vo: रमेश ने सिर हिलाया, पर पर्ची कहाँ लिखे?
scenes.sub: Ramesh ne sir hilaya, par parchi kahan likhe?
scenes.art: Ramesh looking down at a messy counter full of loose paper slips and a pen, a worried half-smile.

scenes.vo: पिछली बार एक पर्ची खो गई थी।
scenes.sub: Pichhli baar ek parchi kho gayi thi.
scenes.art: A single paper slip lying forgotten under a sack in a dim corner of the shop, dust in the light.
Ramesh pulling his phone from his shirt pocket with one hand while still holding the flour bag, focused look.

scenes.vo: बेचा दबाया, रकम लिखी, नाम लिखा।
scenes.sub: Becha dabaya, rakam likhi, naam likha.

scenes.vo: बाद में देना है, तारीख़ डाली। बस।
scenes.sub: Baad mein dena hai, taareekh daali. Bas.

scenes.vo: दस सेकंड में अगला ग्राहक सामने था।
scenes.sub: Das second mein agla grahak saamne tha.
scenes.art: Ramesh smiling and handing the packed bag to Sharma ji while the next customer steps up, the phone resting on the counter.

scenes.vo: शाम को उसने सारा हिसाब एक जगह देखा।
scenes.sub: Shaam ko usne saara hisaab ek jagah dekha.
scenes.art: Ramesh sitting on a stool in the evening light, closing time, calmly looking at his phone with a cup of tea beside him.

scenes.vo: आपका उधार कहाँ लिखा जाता है?
scenes.sub: Aapka udhaar kahan likha jaata hai?
scenes.art: Close-up of Ramesh looking warmly at the viewer, holding his phone, shop shelves softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
